description: This file is a shell script that contains a test suite for 'git rebase --autostash' functionality. It sets up various git repositories, commits, and branches, then runs tests to verify the behavior of autostash during rebase under different conditions, including success, failure, conflicts, and hooks.

methods.name: create_expected_success_apply
methods.description: Creates the expected output file for a successful apply rebase with autostash.

methods.name: create_expected_success_merge
methods.description: Creates the expected output file for a successful merge rebase with autostash.

methods.name: create_expected_failure_apply
methods.description: Creates the expected output file for a failed apply rebase with autostash due to conflicts.

methods.name: create_expected_failure_merge
methods.description: Creates the expected output file for a failed merge rebase with autostash due to conflicts.

methods.name: testrebase
methods.description: Runs a series of tests on 'git rebase' with '--autostash' and various options and scenarios, verifying correct behavior.
